stem: Which ending result or final point follows “For them, it was the sound of youth, hard work, and daily life.”?
options: A public thank-you may reach the right person in the end.
It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
A sound can be noise to one person and memory to another.
It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.
